headline: The 2027 Budget Will Finance the Main Tasks of the State
summary: The draft state and consolidated budgets of Azerbaijan for 2027 are designed to fully cover the main duties and functions of the state. The budget is under parliamentary review.
why: A national budget sets government spending and revenue targets that shape domestic demand and fiscal stability.
